Asset IDs The Unity Editor frequently checks the contents of the Assets folder against the list of assets it already knows about. When you place an asset in the Assets folder, Unity detects that you have added a new file and assigns a unique ID to the asset. This is an ID that Unity uses internally to reference the asset, so that it can move or rename the asset without breaking anything. You can use the Import Activity window to view the ID of an asset.
